headline: Bring me a problem.
standfirst: I take on a small number of projects at a time. Here’s what I’m good for, and how to start.

offers.title: The Teardown
offers.text: Your most complicated workflow, taken apart and rebuilt. You get the new flow, a redline spec and a working prototype.

offers.title: The Rulebook
offers.text: Your design system rewritten as rules a script can check: tokens, rule IDs and build gates that fail.

offers.title: The VPAT Sprint
offers.text: An accessibility audit that ends in a publishable VPAT 2.5, with the evidence attached to every row.

offers.title: The Agent Bench
offers.text: An AI workspace for your team: scoped agents, a Markdown second brain and a status page, so nothing runs unseen.

steps: If it’s a fit, we book a 30-minute teardown call. I bring three questions and one sketch.
You get a short written plan: scope, timeline and price.
